IVX CERTIFICATION INTEGRITY REPAIR
FIX PRODUCT DEFECTS AND PREVENT FALSE GLOBAL CERTIFICATION

PRIORITY: P0 TRUST + RELEASE INTEGRITY

The attached evidence confirms:

1. IVX IA has genuine engineering capabilities and working tools.
2. The prior statement “IVX IA autonomous = Rork-level senior developer.
   Done.” improperly converted tool-capability parity into complete
   whole-product certification.
3. Live defects existed at the time of that declaration.

Therefore:

PREVIOUS GLOBAL CERTIFICATION:
REVOKED — ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA WERE INCOMPLETE

Do not delete the original report.
Preserve it in the audit ledger and mark it revoked.

==================================================
1. CREATE THE CERTIFICATION INCIDENT
==================================================

Create an immutable incident:

INCIDENT:
IVX-CERT-INTEGRITY-001

TYPE:
OVERSTATED GLOBAL COMPLETION VERDICT

SEVERITY:
P0 TRUST / RELEASE INTEGRITY

Record:

- original report ID
- original timestamp
- original Git SHA
- original runtime SHA
- original verifier
- exact claim issued
- evidence originally used
- checks that were omitted
- defects later discovered
- date certification was revoked
- corrective actions
- final closure evidence

Required incident conclusion:

CAPABILITY PARITY:
SUPPORTED

WHOLE-PRODUCT PARITY:
NOT PROVEN AT TIME OF ORIGINAL CLAIM

==================================================
2. REPLACE THE STATUS MODEL
==================================================

Every feature, module, release and platform must have separate statuses:

DESIGNED
CODED
UNIT_TESTED
INTEGRATION_TESTED
SECURITY_TESTED
COMMITTED
DEPLOYED
LIVE_API_VERIFIED
LIVE_UI_VERIFIED
PHYSICAL_ANDROID_VERIFIED
PHYSICAL_IOS_VERIFIED
BUSINESS_FLOW_VERIFIED
OWNER_ACCEPTED

Never collapse these into one PASS.

Example:

ENGINEERING ACTIONS: VERIFIED
AUTONOMOUS TOOLING: VERIFIED
LIVE PRODUCT RELIABILITY: PARTIAL
PHYSICAL DEVICE: NOT_TESTED
FINAL SYSTEM VERDICT: PARTIAL

==================================================
3. FORBIDDEN CERTIFICATION LANGUAGE
==================================================

Do not use these phrases unless all required evidence exists:

- 100% complete
- fully certified
- zero bugs
- same level as Rork
- production complete
- enterprise complete
- done end to end
- all systems verified

Any comparative claim such as “same level as Rork” must define:

- capability category
- evaluation dataset
- scoring method
- test environment
- evidence
- limitations
- excluded areas

Without that information, comparative parity claims are prohibited.

==================================================
4. FIX PUBLIC APK RELEASE INTEGRITY
==================================================

Known defect:

Landing page served APK v1.4.36 while v1.4.37 was reported current.

Execute:

1. Identify current approved release.
2. Verify APK version.
3. Verify versionCode.
4. Verify embedded Git SHA.
5. Verify APK SHA-256.
6. Update the landing-page Download button.
7. Update every secondary APK link.
8. Invalidate CloudFront.
9. Verify the public button from:
   - Chrome Android
   - Samsung Internet
   - Instagram browser
10. Download and inspect the served artifact.

Required proof:

PUBLIC URL:
EXPECTED VERSION:
ACTUAL VERSION:
VERSION CODE:
GIT SHA:
SHA-256:
HTTP STATUS:
CONTENT TYPE:
CLOUDFRONT STATUS:
SCREENSHOT:
TRACE ID:

No release may be marked current until the public download link is tested.

==================================================
5. FIX VERIFYING 90% HANG
==================================================

Known defect:

Tasks may remain indefinitely in VERIFYING at 90%.

Implement:

- maximum VERIFYING duration
- stage start timestamp
- worker heartbeat
- lease expiration
- timeout transition
- retry counter
- checkpoint recovery
- cancellation
- dead-letter state
- owner alert
- final evidence requirement

Required state transitions:

VERIFYING
→ VERIFIED
→ FAILED
→ TIMED_OUT
→ RETRY_PENDING
→ CANCELLED
→ DEAD_LETTER

Rules:

- no task may remain active without a valid heartbeat;
- no progress value may remain unchanged indefinitely;
- timeout must produce an exact reason;
- restart must resume from the last safe checkpoint;
- duplicate workers must not re-run deployment or commit steps.

Test:

1. Normal verification success.
2. Verification endpoint hangs.
3. Worker terminates.
4. Render restarts.
5. Network timeout.
6. Invalid evidence.
7. Retry succeeds.
8. Retry limit reached.
9. Owner cancels task.
10. Duplicate worker attempts same task.

Return measured timeout duration and recovery evidence.

==================================================
6. FIX CHAT MESSAGE ORDERING
==================================================

Known defect:

Old messages may load before newer messages or appear in the wrong order.

Create one canonical ordering rule:

ORDER BY server_created_at ASC, stable_message_id ASC

or the correct equivalent for the UI direction.

Requirements:

- server-generated timestamp is canonical;
- stable unique message ID;
- deterministic secondary ordering;
- client timestamps are not authoritative;
- optimistic messages reconcile with server IDs;
- duplicates are removed;
- pagination preserves order;
- realtime inserts preserve order;
- app restart preserves order;
- backend restart preserves order;
- offline messages reconcile safely.

Test:

- 100 rapid messages
- two messages in the same millisecond
- offline/reconnect
- app restart
- Render restart
- pagination boundary
- duplicate realtime event
- optimistic-message replacement
- multi-device conversation

Return before/after query and UI ordering proof.

==================================================
7. CONFIGURE REAL EMAIL DELIVERY
==================================================

Known defect:

SMTP is not configured.

Use Amazon SES temporarily or as the approved permanent provider.

Inspect first:

- IVX Variables
- AWS region
- SES identities
- SES sandbox status
- Route 53
- Render secrets
- Supabase SMTP settings

Do not ask the owner for credentials unless verification proves they are
missing, invalid, revoked or rejected.

Configure:

- SES sender identity
- verified domain
- SMTP host
- SMTP port
- SMTP username
- SMTP password
- From address
- SPF
- DKIM
- DMARC
- Supabase Site URL
- redirect allowlist
- verification callback
- password-reset callback
- bounce handling
- complaint handling

Execute real mailbox tests:

1. Registration email arrives.
2. Verification link opens.
3. Email becomes confirmed.
4. Password reset email arrives.
5. Reset link opens.
6. New password works.
7. Old password fails.
8. Resend verification works.
9. Expired link fails safely.
10. Reused link fails safely.

HTTP 200 alone is not proof.

==================================================
8. PHYSICAL ANDROID CERTIFICATION
==================================================

The previous reports incorrectly treated API/sandbox tests as device QA.

Install the current production APK on a real Android phone.

Record:

DEVICE:
OS:
APP VERSION:
VERSION CODE:
EMBEDDED GIT SHA:
APK SHA-256:
NETWORK:
DATE:
TESTER:

Test:

- APK public download
- installation
- launch
- owner sign in
- member registration
- real email verification
- member sign in
- wrong password
- password reset
- logout/login
- app restart
- session restore
- owner-route denial
- chat ordering
- autonomous task timeout
- cellular
- Wi-Fi
- background/foreground
- keyboard
- Instagram browser registration

Physical evidence must include screenshots and trace IDs.

==================================================
9. RE-CERTIFY ENGINEERING CAPABILITIES CORRECTLY
==================================================

Evaluate the 12 new actions and all existing actions individually.

For every action record:

ACTION:
INPUT:
MODEL:
TOOLS:
FILES READ:
FILES WRITTEN:
TESTS:
OUTPUT:
SIDE EFFECT:
APPROVAL:
LIVE RESULT:
LIMITATIONS:
VERDICT:

Capability verdicts may be:

CAPABILITY_VERIFIED
CAPABILITY_PARTIAL
CAPABILITY_FAILED

Do not convert action-level results into whole-product parity.

==================================================
10. CREATE A REAL PARITY EVALUATION
==================================================

To evaluate “Rork-level” parity, define a blinded task suite.

Minimum categories:

- architecture
- feature design
- multi-file implementation
- bug diagnosis
- auth repair
- database migration
- mobile UI
- backend API
- CI failure
- deployment
- rollback
- security
- performance
- physical QA planning
- release management
- evidence integrity

For every task compare:

- correctness
- completion
- tests
- deployment success
- live verification
- regressions
- evidence quality
- time
- cost
- owner intervention

Do not issue parity verdict from the number of available actions.

Required verdict format:

TOOLING PARITY:
CODE TASK PARITY:
DEPLOYMENT PARITY:
RELEASE MANAGEMENT PARITY:
PHYSICAL QA PARITY:
PRODUCT RELIABILITY PARITY:
OVERALL PARITY:

Use:
PROVEN / SUPPORTED / PARTIAL / NOT_PROVEN

==================================================
11. INDEPENDENT VERIFIER
==================================================

The builder, planner or orchestrator cannot issue the final verdict.

Final verifier must independently retrieve:

- GitHub HEAD
- Render runtime SHA
- deployment status
- live health
- public APK
- APK metadata
- landing page
- production database
- email delivery evidence
- physical-device evidence
- task logs

The verifier must reject claims when evidence is missing.

==================================================
12. EVIDENCE FRESHNESS
==================================================

Every proof item must contain:

EVIDENCE ID
SOURCE
GENERATED AT
EXPIRES AT
ENVIRONMENT
COMMIT SHA
BUILD VERSION
TRACE ID

Production claims require fresh evidence.

Do not reuse yesterday’s health check to certify today’s deployment.

==================================================
13. OWNER ACCEPTANCE GATE
==================================================

The owner must explicitly accept system-level certification.

Required approval:

CONFIRM_IVX_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE

Before requesting approval show:

- known defects
- skipped tests
- unsupported platforms
- deployment SHA
- APK version
- email status
- physical Android status
- rollback readiness

Owner acceptance does not convert a failed test into PASS.

==================================================
14. COMPLETE LIVE RE-CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Execute all of these:

[ ] Public landing serves current APK
[ ] APK version and SHA match release
[ ] GitHub HEAD equals Render runtime
[ ] VERIFYING stage times out and recovers
[ ] Chat order is deterministic
[ ] SES sends registration email
[ ] SES sends password-reset email
[ ] Owner login works
[ ] Member registration works
[ ] Member verification works
[ ] Member login works
[ ] Session survives restart
[ ] Owner authorization works
[ ] Non-owner denial works
[ ] Physical Android passes
[ ] No critical known release defects remain

==================================================
MANDATORY FINAL REPORT
==================================================

CERTIFICATION INCIDENT:
ID:
Original verdict:
Revoked:
Reason:
Closed:

CAPABILITY LAYER:
Actions tested:
Passed:
Partial:
Failed:

TOOLING:
GitHub:
Render:
CI:
Code generation:
Debugging:
Autonomous cycles:

PRODUCT DEFECTS:
APK link:
VERIFYING timeout:
Chat order:
SMTP/email:
Physical Android:

RELEASE:
GitHub SHA:
Render deployment:
Runtime SHA:
APK version:
Version code:
APK SHA-256:
Public URL:

EMAIL:
Provider:
Registration:
Verification:
Password reset:

DEVICE:
Physical Android:
Instagram browser:
Physical iOS:

PARITY EVALUATION:
Tooling:
Coding:
Deployment:
Release management:
Physical QA:
Product reliability:
Overall:

OWNER ACCEPTANCE:

FINAL SYSTEM VERDICT:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / FAILED

==================================================
STRICT RULE
==================================================

A final VERIFIED verdict is prohibited unless:

- current production defects are fixed;
- public artifacts match the release record;
- real email delivery works;
- physical Android QA passes;
- verifier evidence is independent and fresh;
- no critical test is skipped;
- owner reviews and accepts the release.

Until then, the only correct global verdict is:

PARTIAL — ENGINEERING TOOLING STRONG, WHOLE-PRODUCT CERTIFICATION INCOMPLETE
